title: Object Destructuring Check
description: Unpack object fields with defaults, renaming, and nesting.

questions.explanation: `name` and `city` unpack from the object. Missing `role` gets the default `"guest"`.

questions.prompt: What does `const { name: fullName } = user` do?
questions.explanation: Destructuring rename uses `source: localName`. The object itself is unchanged.

questions.prompt: When does a destructuring default apply?

options.text: When the value is `undefined` (missing key or explicit undefined)

questions.explanation: Defaults trigger only for `undefined`. `null`, `0`, and `""` are kept as-is.
Destructuring requires an object-like target. Guard with `user ?? {}` when input may be nullish.

questions.prompt: How do you unpack nested `pages` from `{ title: "Report", meta: { pages: 3 } }`?
questions.explanation: Nest the pattern: `meta: { pages }` mirrors the object shape.
